metadata.question: Did the coastal city of La Serena experience at least 6cm of rainfall in July 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for July 2022 over a 6 km buffer around a point in La Serena, Chile. If empty, fall back to ERA5-Land Hourly total_precipitation summed to mm.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (precipitation products are not optical). Just ensure valid pixel count within ROI.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Check collection size; if 0 and fallback also 0 -> C1. After summation, count valid pixels; if 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range (<0 or >1000 mm) -> C3. Otherwise compare monthly mean mm >= 60.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roiCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.26, -29.91]); // La Serena, slightly inland to avoid ocean-only pixels
    const roi = roiCenter.buffer(6000); // 6 km buffer approximating the city area
    const start = ee.Date('2022-07-01');
    const end = ee.Date('2022-08-01');
    const scale = 5000;

    console.log('ROI center: -29.91, -71.26 (6 km buffer)');

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let datasetUsed = 'CHIRPS Daily';
    let sumImg = null;

    const chirpsCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('precipitation');
    const chirpsSize = chirpsCol.size().getInfo();

    if (chirpsSize === 0) {
      // Fallback to ERA5-Land Hourly
      const eraCol = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('total_precipitation'); // meters per hour
      const eraSize = eraCol.size().getInfo();
      if (eraSize === 0) {
        console.log('CHIRPS Jul 2022 Images: 0');
        console.log('ERA5-Land Jul 2022 Images: 0');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
        console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
        return;
      }
      const eraMmCol = eraCol.map(function(img) {
        return img.multiply(1000).rename('mm').copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
      });
      sumImg = eraMmCol.sum().rename('precipitation'); // mm in July
      datasetUsed = 'ERA5-Land Hourly (converted to mm)';
      console.log(`CHIRPS Jul 2022 Images: 0`);
      console.log(`ERA5-Land Jul 2022 Images: ${eraSize}`);
    } else {
      sumImg = chirpsCol.sum(); // mm in July
      console.log(`CHIRPS Jul 2022 Images: ${chirpsSize}`);
    }

    // 3. Processing: Count valid pixels to detect C2
    const countDict = sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();

    const validCount = countDict ? (countDict['precipitation'] || 0) : 0;

    if (validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}`);
      console.log('Valid pixels after processing: 0');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: Mean monthly total rainfall over ROI
    const meanDict = sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();

    const meanMm = meanDict ? meanDict['precipitation'] : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (meanMm === null || isNaN(meanMm) || meanMm < 0 || meanMm > 1000) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}`);
      console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validCount}`);
      console.log(`Monthly rainfall mean (mm): ${meanMm}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None, NaN, or invalid).');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    const meets = meanMm >= 60;
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}`);
    console.log(`Valid pixels: ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`Monthly rainfall mean (mm): ${meanMm.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`>= 60 mm? ${meets ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);
    console.log(meets ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D: Processing or API Error');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
